items.title: Oracle patches EBS zero-day exploited in Clop data theft attacks
items.description: Oracle is warning about a critical E-Business Suite zero-day vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-61882 that allows attackers to perform unauthenticated remote code execution, with the flaw actively exploited in Clop data theft attacks. [...]
